prompt: Another team needs a one-off copy of a database without scheduling recurring backups. Which action produces an on-demand copy you can later import elsewhere?
explanation: Export writes a copy of the database to storage on demand: it first saves a temporary copy on the node's local storage, then transfers it to the destination you pick (FTP, SFTP, S3, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage, or a local mount point), and fails if there is not enough space for either step. Recurring backups are a separate feature, configured under the database's Durability settings.

options.text: Export, from the database's additional actions menu
Enable periodic backups with an hourly interval
Generate a support package, which already contains the dataset
Run rladmin cluster debug_info and extract the data from the archive
